name: empiricompany/harbor
description: Docker-based local development environment and CLI for Maho Commerce applications, orchestrating development runtimes and services.

scripts.lint: if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null; then shellcheck bin/harbor tests/harbor.sh; else echo 'shellcheck is not installed'; fi
scripts.format: if command -v shfmt >/dev/null; then shfmt -w bin/harbor tests/harbor.sh; else echo 'shfmt is not installed'; fi
